picks.title: Cubase 16 adds six-part stem separation and AI vocals
picks.excerpt: Steinberg's Cubase 16 adds six-stem separation and Yamaha's upgraded Omnivocal AI singing synthesizer, plus instrument layering. Off-list: allowed outlets' Cubase 16 pieces barely mention the AI features.
picks.rationale: A major DAW version ships built-in six-stem separation and an AI singing synth, so Cubase users get both without third-party plugins.

picks.title: NewJeans' Contract Reportedly Gives Label Right to Use AI-Generated Versions of Their Voices
picks.excerpt: A New York Times report on NewJeans' ADOR contracts says the label holds indefinite rights to AI-generated versions of the members' voices and likenesses. Off-list: Pitchfork's version omits the AI clause.
picks.rationale: A concrete K-pop contract clause giving a label indefinite AI voice and likeness rights, a reference point for artist deal terms.

picks.title: Mashup Edu's AI-agent Nia is designed to 'run the business side' of indie acts' careers
picks.excerpt: Indian music-education platform Mashup Edu launches Nia, an AI agent that handles release planning and admin for independent artists.
picks.rationale: A new agent product that takes over release planning and admin for independent artists, the business-side counterpart to the creation tools.

picks.title: Nile Rodgers Defends AI Use in Music Video: 'We Created Everything ... The AI Did What We Told It to Do'
picks.excerpt: Nile Rodgers defended the AI-generated visuals in an upcoming Christmas charity music video after fan backlash, saying the team created everything and the AI only executed their direction.
picks.rationale: A legacy hitmaker publicly defends an AI-made video after fan backlash; Rolling Stone is the primary report among three outlets covering it.

picks.title: With artificial intelligence on COP31 agenda, IMPALA calls for action on AI and sustainability
picks.excerpt: Ahead of COP31, indie-label body IMPALA calls on the music sector and governments to work together on AI and sustainability. Off-list; page shows date only, time from Google News.
picks.rationale: The European indie-label body's formal call ahead of COP31 adds AI's environmental cost to the music-policy agenda, which no earlier card covered.
